landing.metaTitle: Fellowa | Support and membership platform for creators

hero.eyebrow: A dedicated membership platform for Iranian content creators
hero.title:
Turn your creativity

into your working capital
hero.description: Build a page where your fans support you with a monthly membership, reach your exclusive content and stay in direct touch with you.

music.benefit1: Download exclusive tracks in studio quality
music.benefit2: Demo versions and behind the scenes of each track

designer.benefit3: Access to a private gallery of work in progress

support.title: A simple way to receive support
support.text: Build a dedicated page where your fans can find you and support you. This page is the first step in turning casual followers into real fans.

tiers.title: Set up memberships your way
tiers.text: Define several membership levels with the prices and benefits you choose, from behind-the-scenes content to private chat. Each fan picks the level that is worth it to them.

content.title: Publish different kinds of content
content.text: Publish images, video, audio and writing on one page. No more spreading yourself across several apps; everything is in the place your members already know.
content.postBody: See this week's full episode a day before everyone else!

chat.title: Nothing stands between you and your fans
chat.text: Whatever you publish goes straight to your members, and private chat lets you talk with them more closely.
chat.creatorMessage: Thanks! I'll post the full version for special members tomorrow

compare.title: Why Fellowa?
compare.description: How today's methods compare with what Fellowa builds for you

trust.title: Clear, simple and easy to follow

control.title: Creators control their page
control.text: You manage your page's members and communication tools yourself.

receipt.title: Clear receipts and membership status
receipt.text: Each member's payment, membership period and access level can always be seen and followed up.

benefits.title: Benefits are clear before paying
benefits.text: Before joining, a fan can see what benefits each tier has.

iran.title: Designed for Iran
iran.text: The Persian language, payment in Toman and the real needs of Iranian creators are the basis of Fellowa's design.
